main.src: 維乾元元年歲次戊戌九月庚午朔三日壬申，第十三叔、銀青光祿大夫、使持節蒲州諸軍事、蒲州刺史、上輕車都尉、
main.zh: 乾元元年，歲次戊戌，九月初三日壬申，第十三叔、銀青光祿大夫、使持節蒲州諸軍事、蒲州刺史、上輕車都尉，
main.en: In the first year of the Qianyuan era, the year wuxu, on the third day of the ninth month, renshen: I, thirteenth uncle, Grand Master of Splendid Emolument with the Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon, Commissioner with the tally over the military affairs of Puzhou, Governor of Puzhou, Senior Commandant of Light Chariots,
main.simp: 乾元元年，岁次戊戌，九月初三日壬申，第十三叔、银青光禄大夫、使持节蒲州诸军事、蒲州刺史、上轻车都尉，

main.src: 丹陽縣開國侯真卿，以清酌庶羞，祭于亡姪贈贊善大夫季明之靈曰：惟爾挺生，夙標幼德，宗廟瑚璉，階庭蘭玉。
main.zh: 丹陽縣開國侯顏真卿，以清酒和各種祭品，祭奠亡姪、追贈贊善大夫季明的英靈，說：只有你天資挺拔出眾，自幼就顯露美德，是宗廟中的貴重禮器，是庭階前的蘭草玉樹。
main.en: Marquis of Danyang, Zhenqing, offer clear wine and assorted dishes in sacrifice to the spirit of my departed nephew Jiming, posthumously Grand Master of Remonstrance for the Heir Apparent, and say: You were born upright and outstanding, and from early youth showed fine virtue. In the ancestral temple you would have been a precious vessel; in the courtyard, an orchid and a jade tree.
main.simp: 丹阳县开国侯颜真卿，以清酒和各种祭品，祭奠亡姪、追赠赞善大夫季明的英灵，说：只有你天资挺拔出众，自幼就显露美德，是宗庙中的贵重礼器，是庭阶前的兰草玉树。

main.zh: 你常使人心中欣慰，我們正期盼你享受福祿。
main.en: Always you gladdened our hearts, and we hoped to see you enjoy good fortune and emolument.
main.simp: 你常使人心中欣慰，我们正期盼你享受福禄。

main.src: 何圖逆賊間釁，稱兵犯順。
main.zh: 哪裡想到逆賊乘隙作亂，興兵犯上。
main.en: Who could have imagined that the rebels would seize their moment, take up arms and defy the throne?
main.simp: 哪里想到逆贼乘隙作乱，兴兵犯上。

main.zh: 你父親竭盡忠誠，在常山擔任太守。
main.en: Your father gave all his loyalty and held Changshan as governor.
main.simp: 你父亲竭尽忠诚，在常山担任太守。

main.zh: 我當時奉命，也在平原。
main.en: I, at that time, had my own orders and was at Pingyuan.
main.simp: 我当时奉命，也在平原。

main.zh: 仁慈的兄長愛護我，讓你來傳話。
main.en: My kind elder brother cared for me and sent you to bring me his word.
main.simp: 仁慈的兄长爱护我，让你来传话。

main.zh: 你回去之後，就打開了土門。
main.en: After you had gone back, the Tumen pass was opened.
main.simp: 你回去之后，就打开了土门。

main.zh: 土門打開之後，賊兵的兇焰大受挫折。
main.en: Once Tumen was open, the rebels' fierce power was greatly checked.
main.simp: 土门打开之后，贼兵的凶焰大受挫折。

main.zh: 但賊臣不來救援，孤城被圍困逼迫。
main.en: But the traitor ministers did not come to the rescue, and the lone city was besieged and pressed hard.
main.simp: 但贼臣不来救援，孤城被围困逼迫。

main.zh: 父親陷落，兒子遇害，如同巢傾覆而卵破碎。
main.en: The father fell and the son died; the nest was overturned and the eggs were smashed.
main.simp: 父亲陷落，儿子遇害，如同巢倾覆而卵破碎。

main.zh: 上天不悔改降下的災禍，這般毒害是誰造成的？
main.en: Heaven did not repent of the calamity, and who was it that inflicted such cruelty?
main.simp: 上天不悔改降下的灾祸，这般毒害是谁造成的？

main.zh: 想到你遭遇殘害，即使用一百個人的性命也無法贖回。
main.en: When I think of the harm you met, even a hundred lives could not redeem you.
main.simp: 想到你遭遇残害，即使用一百个人的性命也无法赎回。

main.src: 嗚呼哀哉！吾承天澤，移牧河關。
main.zh: 唉，多麼悲哀！我承蒙天恩，調任去治理河關一帶。
main.en: Alas, the grief! I received Heaven's favour and was moved to govern the region of Heguan, on the river frontier.
main.simp: 唉，多么悲哀！我承蒙天恩，调任去治理河关一带。

main.zh: 泉明近來再次前往失陷的常山，
main.en: Quanming recently went again to Changshan, which had fallen once more,
main.simp: 泉明近来再次前往失陷的常山，

main.zh: 帶著你的頭顱和棺木，一起回來。
main.en: and carried your head and your coffin, and came back together with them.
main.simp: 带着你的头颅和棺木，一起回来。

main.zh: 撫念這些往事，心被摧裂，悲痛震動我的心神與面容。
main.en: When I touch these memories my heart breaks; grief shakes my spirit and my face.
main.simp: 抚念这些往事，心被摧裂，悲痛震动我的心神与面容。

main.zh: 等到來日，我再為你占卜選定安葬之地。
main.en: When the day comes, in the distant time, I will divine a resting place for you.
main.simp: 等到来日，我再为你占卜选定安葬之地。

main.zh: 你的魂靈若有知覺，請不要嘆息長久客居他鄉。
main.en: If your soul has knowledge, do not sigh that you have long been a guest far from home.
main.simp: 你的魂灵若有知觉，请不要叹息长久客居他乡。

main.zh: 唉，多麼悲哀！希望你來享用祭品！
main.en: Alas, the grief! Accept this offering!
main.simp: 唉，多么悲哀！希望你来享用祭品！
